title: Select an advertised PipeWire format for USB DACs without S16
problem: FPP assumes S16LE is universally supported. An SMSL SU-1 advertises only S32_LE PCM, so FPP emits an impossible S16LE adapter and PipeWire provides no audio.
reproduce: At the pinned baseline, feed the selector the reporter capability line S32_LE SPECIAL DSD_U32_BE with a successful S32 probe; it still returns S16LE because the missing S16 baseline is treated as an unverifiable universal fallback.
acceptance: S32-only hardware selects S32LE, the fixed-bit-clock S16/S32 regression still keeps S16 when S32 halves the rate, cost-free widening remains enabled, busy non-S16 hardware never falls back to an unadvertised format, and existing configurations regenerate.
repair: Distinguish cards that advertise S16 from those that do not in both C++ and PHP selectors, use an advertised PCM fallback for non-S16 cards, and bump the ALSA sink configuration generation.

verification.limitations: BCL compiles and executes the exact C++ selector against four probe matrices and asserts PHP parity plus configuration generation. A full FPP image and audible output require the reporter's Raspberry Pi 4 and SMSL SU-1.
verification.ownerCheck: Install a build from PR #2958, reboot once so generation 8 rewrites 95-fpp-alsa-sink.conf, confirm the SMSL adapter says audio.format = "S32LE", then play audio and report whether the output device mapping is restored.

negative.outputIncludes: S32-only SMSL: expected S32LE, got S16LE
